## In this demo, we present RNAEventProfiler. For this demonstration, we are utilizing the dataset of m6A RNA methylation events derived from direct RNA sequencing data obtained from De Kesel et al., Blood, 2025. The dataset was generated by processing native RNA molecules using Oxford Nanopore Technologies (ONT) to map the epitranscriptomic modifications in T-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia (T-ALL).

## Load the libraries and the annotation data
```{r}
# Libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(GenomicRanges)
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(RNAEventProfiler)

# Load Annotation Data 
load("../data/ens_anno_115_hs.rda")# Set the path to the directory containing your annotation data
```

## First we create the SE object with the function create_SE_object, we give in input an event matrix, a coverage matrix, rowData and colData of a dataset of m6A RNA methylation events taken from De Kesel, J., et al. (2025). 
```{r}
load("../data/Nanopore_CS_data.rda")

m6A_obj <- generate_SE_object(
  event_counts = m6A_mod_filt, 
  total_counts = m6A_cov_filt, 
  colData = c_anno, 
  rowInfo = r_anno,
  fix_coords = "end" # changes from 0 based to 1 based coordinates
)

rownames(m6A_obj) <- SummarizedExperiment::rowData(m6A_obj)$site_id
```

## Now we apply the run_differential_analysis function which performs differential analysis. Results are saved in the RowData of the SE object
```{r}
# 1. Define all the contrasts you want to analyse
my_contrasts <- list(
  "PDX_vs_Thymus" = "PDX - Thymus", 
  "Primary_vs_Thymus" = "Primary - Thymus"
)

# 2. Run the differential analysis
m6A_obj_DE <- run_differential_analysis(
  se = m6A_obj, condition = "condition", 
  norm_method = "TMM",
  contrasts = my_contrasts,
  stat_type = "PValue",
  method = "LRT",
  p_threshold = 0.05,
  delta_threshold = 0.01,
  use_coverage_offset = TRUE
)

# 3. All the results are in the rowData
head(rowData(m6A_obj_DE))
```

## With this last chunk we are performing genome-to-transcript mapping and creating a metaprofile
(Function still in development)
```{r}
# 1. Map genomic coordinates to transcriptome
m6A_obj_DE_mp_to_tr <- m6A_obj_DE
m6A_obj_DE_mp_to_tr <- map_to_transcriptome(m6A_obj_DE_mp_to_tr, ense, enst, ensg)

# 2. Extract rowData and indicate the position of each site to plot
plot_df <- as.data.frame(rowData(m6A_obj_DE_mp_to_tr))
plot_df$pos <- plot_df$tx_end

# 3. Pivot classification columns to long format
plot_df_long <- plot_df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(PDX_vs_Thymus_Class, Primary_vs_Thymus_Class),
    names_to = "group",
    values_to = "Class"
  )

# 4. Split the data into two separate dataframes: one for the PDX_vs_Thymus and one for the Primary_vs Thymus
df_PDX <- plot_df_long %>% filter(group == "PDX_vs_Thymus_Class" & Class != "=")
df_Primary <- plot_df_long %>% filter(group == "Primary_vs_Thymus_Class" & Class != "=")


df_PDX$Class <- factor(df_PDX$Class, 
                        levels = c("+", "-"), 
                        labels = c("PDX (+)", "PDX (-)"))

df_Primary$Class <- factor(df_Primary$Class, 
                           levels = c("+", "-"), 
                           labels = c("Primary (+)", "Primary (-)"))

# Define color palettes
palette_PDX <- c("PDX (+)" = "#D62828", "PDX (-)" = "#F77F00")
palette_Primary <- c("Primary (+)" = "#003049", "Primary (-)" = "#4EA8DE")

# 5. Preparing annotation object for transcript metaprofile of protein coding genes
row_anno <- enst %>% filter(canonical == "T" & !l_5utr == 0 & !l_cds == 0 & !l_3utr == 0 & transcript_biotype == "protein_coding") %>%
  mutate(tx_5utr_start = 1,
         tx_5utr_end = l_5utr,
         tx_cds_start = l_5utr+1,
         tx_cds_end = l_5utr+l_cds,
         tx_3utr_start = transcript_length - l_3utr + 1,
         tx_3utr_end = transcript_length)

# 6. Metaprofile Calculation

# PROFILE 1: PDX (+) vs PDX (-)
message("Calculating PDX metaprofile...")
p_PDX <- plot_metaprofile(
  df_PDX,
  row_anno,
  split_by = "Class",
  pos_df_cols = c(pos = "pos", transcript_id = "ensembl_transcript_id", count = "site_id"),
  percentages = TRUE,
  total_bins = 100,
  group_colors = palette_PDX,
  smooth = TRUE)

# PROFILE 2: Primary (+) vs Primary (-)
message("Calculating Primary metaprofile...")
p_Primary <- plot_metaprofile(
  df_Primary,
  row_anno,
  split_by = "Class",
  pos_df_cols = c(pos = "pos", transcript_id = "ensembl_transcript_id", count = "site_id"),
  percentages = TRUE,
  total_bins = 100,
  group_colors = palette_Primary,
  smooth = TRUE)

p_PDX
p_Primary
```
